prompt:
Design a high fidelity OmniGear 'Adicionar dispositivo' preconnection UI, consistent with supplied approved HOME comparison. Inherit wordmark, black/white materials, typography and single theme icon, not its demo device contents. Output a SQUARE board of TWO complete desktop landscape views stacked vertically, DARK top and LIGHT bottom, equal dimensions and identical composition.
Header OmniGear left, ONE moon outline icon right on dark, ONE sun outline icon right on light, no switch, no simultaneous pair. Remove Demonstração badge because this state is before entering demo. Underlying home is EMPTY with 'Seus dispositivos' heading, '+ Adicionar dispositivo' action, quiet 'Nenhum dispositivo adicionado'. No hardware already connected, no fictional detected device list.
Flow content EXACT: title 'Adicionar dispositivo'; subtitle 'Conecte seu mouse ou teclado para começar.' Three concise steps using small numeric1,2,3 badges (meaningful sequence): 'Conecte por USB ou receptor compatível.'; 'Clique em Selecionar dispositivo.'; 'Escolha o periférico na janela do navegador.' Small precise line icons of USB plug, mouse and keyboard, not decorative photoreal scenes. Brief helper 'A compatibilidade depende do modelo.' Primary 'Selecionar dispositivo', secondary 'Cancelar', tertiary text link 'Explorar demonstração'. No fake browser permission popup, grant-success state, list of supported brands, driver installation or account. The primary is an action that will open browser selection, not permission already granted. Blackwhite palette, white primary on dark and black primary on white. No dirty/save footer because this is home connection. Crisp readable Brazilian Portuguese.
COMPOSITION2: Right side drawer about44% viewport width, full app height beneath global header. Left portion of empty home remains visible with subtle dim overlay. Drawer title Adicionar dispositivo and close X, subtitle, three vertically arranged numbered steps, compatibility helper, primary Selecionar dispositivo and secondary Cancelar near drawer bottom, Explorar demonstração beneath. Divider left edge, no inner nested card. Strong right-aligned task panel but full content fits. Header theme icon remains visible unobscured.
